full_judgment: 3. The case of plaintiffs' was that the suit land along with over undisputed land originally belonged to the then Zaminder of Baniachong named Moulavi Abu Naser Md. Eahia Khan Bahadur @ Jitu Mia and the predecessor of the plaintiff named Sree Mohendra Chadra Das, Sree Dhanuram Das, Sree Lakshmindor Das, Sree Ramkrishna Das, Sree Bharot Chandra Das, Sree Gopi Mohan Das, Sree Pulchand Das, Sree Eshwar Chandra Das, Sree Ram Hori Das, Sree Mathur Chandra Das, Sree Bijoy Krishna Das, Sree Sadoy Chandra Das and Prohallad Chandra Das, who obtained the 1st scheduled land on the basis of registered patta being No. 4450 of 1921 dated 12 Ashwin, 1328 B.S. executed by Sree Jogendra Mohan Pal it on behalf of the aforesaid Zaminder. The plaintiff were the legal heirs of the aforesaid receipients of the patta and some of the plaintiffs had purchased from the recipients of the patta and from their legal heirs through different kabalas. They were possessing the suit land by cultivating crops from long before as, well as paying rents to the Government, Defendant Nos. 1-16 had no right, title in respect of the 2nd scheduled land. In the first part of January, 2009 the defendants claimed that the 2nd scheduled land was recorded in their favour and gave threat to dispossess the plaintiff there from on the basis of wrong record of right After collecting certified copy of the khatian from the local office the plaintiffs were confirmed about the said recording and by such wrong record, the plaintiff title in the suit land became clouded and hence they filed the suit.
